info.name: Amazon Application Discovery Service Agents Imports API
Amazon Application Discovery Service Start Import Task

items.docs: Starts an import task, which allows you to import details of your on-premises environment directly into AWS Migration Hub without having to use the Application Discovery Service (ADS) tools.

info.name: Amazon Application Discovery Service Describe Import Tasks

items.docs: Returns an array of import tasks for your account, including status information, times, IDs, the Amazon S3 Object URL for the import file, and more.

info.name: Amazon Application Discovery Service Batch Delete Import Data

items.docs: Deletes one or more import tasks, each identified by their import ID. Each import task has a number of records that can identify servers or applications.
